description: Scrape public Facebook Marketplace listings by URL or keyword and location. Supports US city, state, category, price, condition, delivery, sorting, detail, and multi-source searches.

daysSinceListed.description: Optional age filter. Listings without a verifiable creation time are excluded when enabled.
daysSinceListed.title: Listed Within (days)

deduplicateAcrossInputs.description: Emit each listing ID once across sources. Disable to preserve repeated results from repeated input URLs.
deduplicateAcrossInputs.title: Deduplicate Across Inputs

includeAllPhotos.description: Enables deep mode so all photo data exposed by Facebook can be retained.
includeAllPhotos.title: Include All Photos

includeListingDetails.description: Compatibility alias that enables deep detail enrichment.
includeListingDetails.title: Include Listing Details

location.description: Marketplace location slug or city/state value, for example nyc, seattle, or New York, NY.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Global output limit across all sources.
maxItems.title: Maximum Listings

minPrice.description: Optional minimum listing price. Listings without a verifiable price are excluded when this filter is used.
minPrice.title: Minimum Price

proxyConfiguration.description: US residential Apify Proxy is used by default and enforced whenever Apify Proxy is selected because Marketplace access is proxy-dependent.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

radiusKm.description: Optional search radius around the structured location.
radiusKm.title: Radius (km)

resultsLimit.description: Legacy per-source limit retained for existing integrations. maxItemsPerUrl takes precedence when supplied.
resultsLimit.title: Legacy Results Limit

scrapeMode.description: Fast streams search-page records. Deep visits listing pages for additional fields. Auto follows the detail compatibility setting.
scrapeMode.title: Scrape Mode

searchQuery.description: Keyword or phrase for structured Marketplace discovery, for example laptop, furniture, or used bicycle. Requires location when startUrls is omitted.
searchQuery.title: Search Query

sortBy.description: Requested Marketplace sort order; the actor also sorts by verified output values when applicable.
sortBy.title: Sort Order

startUrls.description: One or more Facebook Marketplace search, category, location, or direct item URLs. Use this or searchQuery plus location.

url.description: A valid Facebook Marketplace URL, such as a city feed, search, category, or /marketplace/item/<id> page.
url.title: URL

startUrls.title: Marketplace URLs

title: Facebook Marketplace Scraper Input
